text: Who said you could blow out the candles?
This is Emily's first birthday at our house, so don't compete with her.
Mom, today is also my birthday.
You're my daughter, which is exactly why you should know better.
Mommy, let Zoe blow out the candles with me.
Don't worry about her. Today is just for you.
Zoe, don't block the camera. I want to take pictures of Emily.
Last year you said you would blow out candles with me this year.
Daddy will blow out the candles with you.
Mom, I haven't had any yet.
Save this piece for Emily. She might want some more tonight.
I didn't eat a single bite.
It's just a piece of cake. I'll buy you another tomorrow.
